verdict.rationale: Inline completions are a fair axis for an AI coding product, but the evidence never documents as-you-type inline completions or next-edit suggestions. The Desktop docs mention only generic "AI-powered assistance" when coding. The other evidence covers autonomous agent sessions, CLI, review, and handoff, which are different capabilities.

support.subject: As a developer, I can receive inline code completions and next-edit suggestions as I type
